“**Heaven’s Kingdom is not food and drink, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.**” — Romans 14:17  

The world offers fleeting comforts; the Kingdom demands a life anchored in divine righteousness that transforms every circumstance. When you walk in that authority today, the chaos around you loses its power.  

What righteousness are you choosing to live out right now?
